mapper.select: SELECT t.task_id AS taskId, t.project_id AS projectId, t.project_member_id AS projectMemberId, NVL(md.name, '미지정') AS memberName, t.title AS title, t.content AS content, t.task_level AS taskLevel, TO_CHAR(t.start_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startAt, TO_CHAR(t."END", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS endAt, t.status AS status, t.progress AS progress, TO_CHAR(t.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS created, TO_CHAR(t.updated, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updated FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN project_members pm ON t.project_member_id = pm.project_member_id LEFT JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id LEFT JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id WHERE t.project_id = #{projectId} AND t.deleted IS NULL ORDER BY t.task_level DESC, t.task_id ASC

SELECT st.sub_task_id AS subTaskId, st.task_id AS taskId, st.project_id AS projectId, st.project_member_id AS projectMemberId, NVL(md.name, '미지정') AS memberName, st.title AS title, st.content AS content, TO_CHAR(st.start_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startAt, TO_CHAR(st."END", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS endAt, st.status AS status, st.progress AS progress, TO_CHAR(st.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS created, TO_CHAR(st.updated, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updated FROM sub_tasks st LEFT JOIN project_members pm ON st.project_member_id = pm.project_member_id LEFT JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id LEFT JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id WHERE st.task_id = #{taskId} AND st.deleted IS NULL ORDER BY st.sub_task_id ASC

SELECT t.task_id AS taskId, t.project_id AS projectId, t.project_member_id AS projectMemberId, NVL(md.name, '미지정') AS memberName, t.title AS title, t.content AS content, t.task_level AS taskLevel, TO_CHAR(t.start_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startAt, TO_CHAR(t."END", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS endAt, t.status AS status, t.progress AS progress, TO_CHAR(t.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS created, TO_CHAR(t.updated, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updated FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN project_members pm ON t.project_member_id = pm.project_member_id LEFT JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id LEFT JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id WHERE t.task_id = #{taskId} AND t.deleted IS NULL
mapper.insert:
SELECT seq_tasks.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO tasks ( task_id, project_id, project_member_id, title, content, task_level, start_at, "END", status, progress, created, updated ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{projectId}, #{projectMemberId}, #{title}, #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{taskLevel}, NVL(TO_DATE(#{startAt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), SYSDATE), NVL(TO_DATE(#{endAt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), SYSDATE + 7), #{status}, #{progress}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE tasks SET title = #{title}, content = #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, status = #{status}, start_at = TO_DATE(#{startAt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), "END" = TO_DATE(#{endAt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), updated = SYSDATE WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
